# The Kraft Heinz Company

> Corporate website for The Kraft Heinz Company, a global food and beverage manufacturer focused on iconic brands, sustainability initiatives, and responsible business practices.

Kraft Heinz operates globally with a portfolio of trusted brands across North America and international markets. The company emphasizes sustainability through regenerative agriculture, emissions reduction, and nutrition improvements, while maintaining rigorous ethics and compliance standards including anti-bribery policies, supplier guiding principles, and adherence to frameworks like GRI, SASB, TCFD, and UNGC.

## Key Topics

- The Kraft Heinz Company
- Global brands and food products
- Sustainability and regenerative agriculture
- Ethics and compliance
- Anti-bribery and anti-corruption
- Supplier management and procurement
- Corporate responsibility
- ESG reporting (GRI, SASB, TCFD, UNGC, CDP)
- Equal employment opportunity
- Global Code of Conduct
- Supply chain standards
- Environmental verification (Bureau Veritas, SGS)
- Corporate governance
- Nutrition and product quality
